question: What is the source of the appearance of division?
premises: A limitation born of conceptualization may afterward show division.
That very showing of division is māyā.
Māyā belongs to the free one and reveals a vision of difference.
inference: The appearance of division is māyā, a power of the free absolute that manifests difference.
plain_english: For the limitation born of conceptualization may afterward show division; that very division is māyā, the power of the free one that reveals the vision of difference.
